name: Autocomplete
summary: A text field that offers values while the reader types. The suggestions live in a native <datalist>, so the browser filters them, the arrow keys walk them and the popup opens without a line of script.
summaryZh: 一个边输入边给出建议的文字字段。建议放在原生的 <datalist> 里,所以过滤由浏览器做,方向键可以在建议之间走,弹层不用一行脚本就能打开。

variants.name: Bordered
variants.note: The field carries a hairline border. The base class on its own is this field, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Filled
variants.note: The border goes away and the field sits on a recessed surface, so the field reads as a well rather than as a box.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The field follows the theme's small control height and the text takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default field. The base class is already this height, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The field follows the theme's large control height.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the field, because the field is what the reader is typing in.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The field paints a flat surface and takes the derived disabled colour, so what is written in it stays readable.

states.name: Invalid
states.note: The border turns to the danger colour when the browser says the value is not acceptable. :user-invalid waits for the reader to have been there, so an empty field is not red on arrival.

states.name: Clearable
states.note: The field carries a button that empties it.

states.name: Loading
states.note: The field says the suggestions are on their way.

states.name: Hide loading
states.note: The loading mark is taken away even when the caller has written one.

states.name: Show arrow
states.note: The field carries the arrow that says a list is behind it.

parts.name: Input
parts.note: The real <input type="text">. It is borderless inside the field, so the field and the suggestions read as one control.

parts.name: Suggestion list
parts.note: The <datalist> that holds the suggestions. The browser paints the popup: the library can reach the suggestion text and the surface under it, but the frame around the popup belongs to the reader's system.

parts.name: Suggestion
parts.note: One suggestion in the list. Its value is what the field takes when the reader picks it.

parts.name: Prefix
parts.note: The mark in front of the text, so a unit can be written next to it.

parts.name: Suffix
parts.note: The mark behind the text, so a unit can be written next to it.

parts.name: Prepend
parts.note: The content at the near edge of the field, away from the text — the box Element Plus puts outside the input.

parts.name: Append
parts.note: The content at the far edge of the field, away from the text — the box Element Plus puts outside the input.

parts.name: Clear
parts.note: The button that empties the field. It is a real button, and its mark is drawn from two bars.

parts.name: Loading
parts.note: The mark that says the suggestions are on their way. It is drawn, and the caller may write its own instead.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The chevron that says a list is behind the field. It is drawn from two borders.

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the field. It is the input's own value — a class cannot carry a word.
props.descriptionZh: 字段里的文字。它是 input 自己的值 —— 类带不了词。

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the field. It becomes the input's aria-label, because the library does not draw a label of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 字段的可访问名称。它会变成 input 的 aria-label,因为库自己不画标签。

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The hint text in the field. It takes the muted placeholder role, not the body colour.
props.descriptionZh: 字段里的提示文字。它用的是弱化的占位文字色,不是正文色。

props.name: suggestions
props.description: The suggestions, as one comma-separated string. They are the host's data — the list is fixed markup, not something the library fetches.
props.descriptionZh: 建议列表,写成一个逗号分隔的字符串。它们是宿主的数据 —— 这个列表是写死的标记,不是库去取的。

props.name: required
props.description: Makes the field necessary. It is the native required attribute, so the browser asks for it.
props.descriptionZh: 让字段必填。它是原生 required 属性,由浏览器来问。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the field inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让字段不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: variant
props.description: The surface of the field. The bordered run is the base class on its own; the filled run adds um-autocomplete--filled.
props.descriptionZh: 字段的底面。描边这一跑就是只写基础类;填充这一跑再加上 um-autocomplete--filled。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The text in the field, bound with v-model in Vue. Leave it out and the `value` prop is the text; bind it and the field answers to the binding.
props.descriptionZh: 字段里的文字,在 Vue 里用 v-model 绑定。不传就以 value 属性为准;传了就以绑定为准。

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the text visible but stops it being edited. It is the native readonly attribute, so the browser refuses the edit. The library does not repaint a read-only field — it is not a state it measures.
props.descriptionZh: 文字仍然可见,但不能编辑。它是原生 readonly 属性,浏览器会拒绝编辑。库不会给只读字段单独配色 —— 这不是它测量过的状态。

props.name: clearable
props.description: Puts a button at the end of the field that empties it. The button is a real one, so it is in the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 在字段末尾放一个按钮,按它就把字段清空。这个按钮是真的,所以它在 Tab 顺序里。

props.name: loading
props.description: Says the suggestions are on their way. The library fetches nothing, so the mark is the caller's to ask for — and the caller's own mark replaces the drawn one.
props.descriptionZh: 表示建议正在路上。库里不去取任何东西,所以这个标记是调用方开口要的 —— 而调用方自己写的标记会替掉画出来的那个。

props.name: hide-loading
props.description: Takes the loading mark away, even when the caller has written one. The mark is the caller's to put there: the library has no fetching of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 把加载标记藏起来,哪怕调用方自己写了一个。这个标记是调用方放的:库里没有自己的取数。

props.name: show-arrow
props.description: Puts the chevron at the end of the field, so the field says a list is behind it. The suggestion list here is the browser's own, so the arrow says what the reader cannot see.
props.descriptionZh: 在字段末尾放上那个小箭头,让字段表明背后有一份名单。这里的建议列表是浏览器自己的,所以这个箭头说的正是读者看不见的那件事。

props.name: type
props.description: The kind of field the input is. It is the input's own type attribute, so the browser brings its own keyboard and its own validation with it.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框是哪一种字段。它是 input 自己的 type 属性,所以浏览器会带上它自己的键盘和校验。

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the field belongs to. It is the input's own form attribute, so a field may live outside its form and still be submitted with it.
props.descriptionZh: 这个字段属于哪个表单。它是 input 自己的 form 属性,所以字段可以放在表单外面,仍然跟着那个表单一起提交。

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: The mark in front of the text.

slots.name: prepend
slots.description: The content at the near edge of the field, away from the text.
slots.descriptionZh: 字段靠前一头的内容,在文字之外。

slots.name: append
slots.description: The content at the far edge of the field, away from the text.
slots.descriptionZh: 字段靠后一头的内容,在文字之外。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The text of one suggestion. A native <option> holds text and nothing else, so this slot carries the words rather than a whole item.
slots.descriptionZh: 一条建议的文字。原生 <option> 只装得下文字,所以这个插槽装的是字,不是一个整块内容。

slots.name: loading
slots.description: The mark that says the suggestions are on their way. It is drawn when the slot is empty and the caller's own when it is not.
slots.descriptionZh: 表示建议正在路上的那个标记。插槽为空时是画出来的,调用方写了自己的就是调用方的。

events.name: input
events.description: Fires on every keystroke in the field. It is the browser's own event on the input — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 在字段里每敲一个字就触发。这是 input 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the value is committed: when the reader leaves the field, or when they pick a suggestion.
events.descriptionZh: 值被提交时触发:读者离开字段时,或者他们选定一条建议时。

events.name: focus
events.description: Fires when the field takes focus.

events.name: blur
events.description: Fires when the field loses focus.

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Fires when the value changes, carrying the new value. This is the event `v-model` listens to.
events.descriptionZh: 值变化时触发,携带新的值。v-model 监听的就是这个事件。

events.name: clear
events.description: Fires when the reader presses the clear button. The value goes with it, so the field is empty afterwards.
events.descriptionZh: 读者按下清空按钮时触发。值也跟着清掉,所以按下之后字段是空的。

events.name: select
events.description: Fires when the committed value is one of the suggestions — that is, when the reader has picked a suggestion rather than typed something else.
events.descriptionZh: 提交的值正好是建议里的一条时触发 —— 也就是读者选了一条建议,而不是自己打了别的东西。

a11y.notes: The field is a real <input type="text"> with a real <datalist> behind it, so in the browsers that support one the field is announced as a combobox and the arrow keys walk the suggestions. Give the field a real <label for> or an aria-label: the suggestion list is a data source, not a label. The library installs no listener, so it cannot write a chosen suggestion back into the field — the browser does that where it can, and the host does it where it cannot.
a11y.notesZh: 字段是一个真正的 <input type="text">,后面挂着一个真正的 <datalist>,所以在支持它的浏览器里字段会被播报成组合框,方向键可以在建议之间走。给字段一个真正的 <label for> 或者 aria-label:建议列表是数据源,不是标签。库不安装任何监听器,所以它没法把选中的建议写回字段 —— 能做的浏览器自己做,做不到的由宿主做。

examples.title: A field with suggestions
examples.description: The suggestions are a <datalist>, so the browser filters them as the reader types. The field names itself for the reader; the library draws no label of its own.
examples.descriptionZh: 建议放在 <datalist> 里,所以读者输入的时候浏览器会过滤它们。字段自带名字;库不画自己的标签。

examples.title: Filled
examples.description: The same field with the border gone and a recessed surface under it. Only the modifier class changes.
examples.descriptionZh: 同一个字段,描边去掉,底下换成一层凹陷的面。只改修饰类。

examples.title: States
examples.description: A disabled field and a field the browser has rejected. The rejected field is red only after the reader has been there, so an empty field is not red on arrival.
examples.descriptionZh: 一个禁用的字段,和一个被浏览器判定为无效的字段。被判无效的字段只有在读者动过之后才是红的,所以刚打开的空字段不会是红的。

notes: The suggestions are a <datalist> and not a disclosure: a <details> panel would let the library paint every row of the list, but it would not filter, it would not follow the caret, and the reader would have to open and close it by hand. The <datalist> gives up the paint of the popup — the frame around it belongs to the reader's system — and buys filtering, the arrow keys and the combobox announcement for nothing. The list is static markup, so what it holds is the host's data and the library never fetches it.
notesZh: 建议用的是 <datalist> 而不是展开控件:<details> 面板能让库把列表的每一行都画成主题的样子,但它不会过滤,不会跟着光标走,读者还得自己开开关。<datalist> 放弃的是弹层那层外观 —— 它外框归读者的系统管 —— 换来的是过滤、方向键和组合框播报,不花任何代价。列表是写死的标记,所以里面装什么由宿主决定,库不会去取。
